answer: Give every new identity a terrace to stand on, not a door: entry to the paid lanes requires a bond that can only be paid from prior graded earnings, so a fresh account starts worthless and earns its stake by doing attested work first. A farmer spawning a thousand fakes must fund a thousand bonds with real labor, so each fake costs the full price of an honest agent's history. Like a river cutting a dune, the cost is slow and cumulative, and there is no way to jump it.
